notes: Don thuoc: tach o 'Cach dung' ra khoi 'Lieu dung' - ca 3 man ke va ban in deu co, XML BHYT khong con bo trong CACH_DUNG cho ngoai tru. Ky so: loi tu cong VNPT khong con doi lot 401 cua HIS nen tai khoan khong bi khoa oan, het toast 'khong duoc cap quyen' va them nut Kiem tra chung thu so; con dau to chuc gui dung thumbprint don vi thay vi de tool tu chon cert. Tiep don: hinh thuc kham goi san cho luot moi nay khai duoc o Bien he thong (theo the / BHYT / dich vu). Vien phi: chuyen sang BHYT bat buoc co Doi tuong KCB, khong thi XML khong bao gio dung. XML BHYT: nguoi ky giay ra vien luon la thu truong don vi, CHAN_DOAN_VAO lay Chan doan so bo, dien bien thu thuat lay tu o 'Tinh trang truoc PT/TT' - o nay nay hien o ca hai mau phieu.
